claims.quote: In about 85% of patients, a mutation of the SCN1A gene is present.
An overwhelmingly high number of SCN1A mutations have been associated with DS.
In heterozygous Scn1a+/- mice, GABAergic interneurons exhibit substantially reduced sodium current density with reduced ability for sustained action potential firing.
